name: College of Lore

source.note: Entered from knowledge of the 2024 PHB; compare every number with the book before setting checked_against.

summary: A collector of secrets who learns spells from other traditions and blunts foes with Cutting Words.

feature.name: Bonus Proficiencies
feature.summary: Proficiency in three skills of your choice.
feature.text: You gain proficiency with three skills of your choice.

feature.name: Cutting Words
feature.summary: Reaction: spend Bardic Inspiration to subtract the die from a creature's damage roll, or from an attack roll or ability check it succeeds on.
feature.text: When a creature you can see within 60 feet of you makes a damage roll or succeeds on an ability check or attack roll, you can take a Reaction and expend a use of Bardic Inspiration; roll the die and subtract the number from the creature's roll, possibly turning a success into a failure.

feature.name: Magical Discoveries
feature.summary: Learn two spells from the Cleric, Druid or Wizard lists; they're always prepared.
feature.text: You learn two spells of your choice from the Cleric, Druid or Wizard spell lists, in any combination. Each must be a cantrip or a spell of a level you have Bard spell slots for. They are always prepared and count as Bard spells. Whenever you gain a Bard level you can replace one of them with another spell that qualifies.

feature.name: Peerless Skill
feature.summary: When you fail an ability check or attack roll, add a Bardic Inspiration die; the use isn't spent if it still fails.
